question: What post-subagent completion hook contract should OpenClaw support, if any, and how should it bound child output/history exposure plus announcement mutation or suppression?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing payload fields, ordering, timeout/error behavior, delivery-result visibility, and plugin authority is a security and product API decision that automation should not lock in.

options.title: Typed plugin delivery hook
options.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Fold into broader lifecycle design
options.body: Hold this specific request until the broader lifecycle hook design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454 settles one event model across subagents, turns, and tool thresholds.

options.title: Observation-only event
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation/suppression to separate delivery-policy work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed plugin delivery hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue review and recent subagent announce/thread-binding history make this the best available owner signal for the product/security API choice.
